info.title: Switch-Toypad
info.author: Space_Raler
info.description: Toy portal emulator for Nintendo Switch
info.details:
Toypad-Emu turns your Nintendo Switch into a USB toy portal for games running on another console or PC. Connect it with a USB-C cable and the game sees a real Skylanders Portal of Power, Disney Infinity base, or LEGO Dimensions ToyPad.

Three modes in one app

Skylanders: a 16-slot portal with full figure read/write support, including Trap Team.
Disney Infinity: a base with player, play set, and power disc slots. Figures are placed in the right slot automatically.
LEGO Dimensions: a seven-position ToyPad laid out like the real one. Tokens can be placed, removed, and moved between pads. Test profiles for every released character and vehicle are generated on first launch.

AI use: Mostly AI-generated. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
